claim: By 2026, more than 80% of enterprises will have used generative AI APIs or deployed GenAI-enabled applications, but only 15% will achieve demonstrable net ROI due to hidden integration, data governance, and ongoing operational costs.
source: Gartner Strategic Predicts: The Cost Reality of Enterprise AI Adoption
evidenceSummary: Cautions enterprise leaders against deploying LLMs for deterministic data integration where rules and standard APIs provide superior reliability at 1/10th the operating cost.

claim: Over 60% of repetitive back-office finance and procurement activities can be solved using deterministic workflow automation, standard ERP configuration, and modern RPA without requiring generative AI.
source: McKinsey Digital: Automation First - Separating Real Business Value from AI Hype
evidenceSummary: Empirical study of 450 Fortune 1000 transformations demonstrating that deterministic rule-based workflows achieve payback in 4 to 7 months compared to 14+ months for custom generative models.

claim: Organizations implementing native ServiceNow Flow Designer and IntegrationHub spokes achieved 68% deflection in Tier-1 IT service desk repetitive tickets without deploying standalone third-party AI copilots.
source: The Total Economic Impact of ServiceNow Native Workflow Automation
evidenceSummary: Demonstrates that native ITSM catalog items, role-based password resets, and automated approval chains solve 7 out of 10 IT requests deterministically.

claim: UiPath reports that unattended document extraction robots using deterministic templates and regex rules process standard structured invoices at 99.4% accuracy, whereas LLM-based zero-shot extraction required secondary human review for 12% of edge cases.
source: UiPath Inc. Annual Regulatory Filing & Technical Whitepaper
evidenceSummary: Official vendor technical disclosure showing hybrid approach: deterministic rules for high-volume templated forms, ML/AI reserved only for variable semi-structured exceptions.

claim: SAP S/4HANA automated 3-way matching executes natively against standard purchase orders and goods receipts with zero external AI tokens required when master data tolerances are correctly configured.
source: SAP Best Practices Guide: Procure-to-Pay Automation Architecture
evidenceSummary: Confirms that native ERP configuration handles invoice matching deterministically, eliminating the need to send invoice PDFs to external GenAI APIs.
